facts.text: John shared a picture of a dog sitting in the grass with a leash, which he described as a cherished memory of his pet.

evidence.quote: Here's a picture of him that I cherish.
Max looks so peaceful in that photo, just chilling in the backyard.

facts.text: Maria expressed that remembering Max as peaceful and happy in the photo is a great way to honor him.

evidence.quote: It's a great way to honor him.
That's how we'll think of him - peaceful and happy.

facts.text: John stated that Max brought them a lot of joy and taught them about love and loyalty.

evidence.quote: He brought us so much joy. It's heartbreaking that he's gone but we're grateful to have had him as part of our family. He taught us a lot about love and loyalty.
He really taught us the importance of unconditional love and loyalty.

facts.text: Maria acknowledged that Max was truly awesome and emphasized the importance of cherishing the lessons he taught.

evidence.quote: Max was truly awesome. Let's cherish the lessons he taught.
I want my kids to learn that too. Our bond with him was so special and something I cherish.
